<h2>Make Cross-Validation Grid Candidates From Fold Resolution</h2>

<h3>Description</h3>

<p>Derives spatial-grid candidates only for spatially stratified grouped
cross-validation.
</p>


<h3>Usage</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>build_cross_validation_grid_candidates_from_resolution(
  data_locations = NULL,
  data_fold_resolution = NULL,
  target_locations_per_cell = 5,
  grid_size_multipliers = 2^base::seq(-2, 2)
)
</code></pre>


<h3>Arguments</h3>

<table role = "presentation">
<tr><td><code id="data_locations">data_locations</code></td>
<td>
<p>Location table returned by [build_cross_validation_location_table()].</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="data_fold_resolution">data_fold_resolution</code></td>
<td>
<p>One-row table returned by [resolve_cross_validation_fold_count()].</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="target_locations_per_cell">target_locations_per_cell</code>, <code id="grid_size_multipliers">grid_size_multipliers</code></td>
<td>
<p>Arguments passed to [build_cross_validation_grid_candidates()].</p>
</td></tr>
</table>


<h3>Value</h3>

<p>Grid-candidate tibble. Gridless strategies return a zero-row tibble with
the stable candidate schema.
</p>


<h3>Examples</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>data_locations &lt;-
  tibble::tibble(
    location_id = base::letters[1:6],
    coord_x_km = base::seq_len(6L),
    coord_y_km = base::seq_len(6L),
    n_samples = base::rep(1L, 6L),
    row_indices = base::as.list(base::seq_len(6L))
  )
data_resolution &lt;-
  resolve_cross_validation_fold_count(6L, 5L)
build_cross_validation_grid_candidates_from_resolution(
  data_locations = data_locations,
  data_fold_resolution = data_resolution
)
</code></pre>
